_what_this_is: For each CAPABILITY the project needs, which implementation is AUTHORITATIVE and which are deprecated. Declared, not inferred.
_why: s099, after JP said it three times: 'es un tema de arquitectura... nuevamente'. The recurring failure was never 'we forgot to wire X'. It is that seven layers exist (CLI graph_queries, MCP server, quality_checks, algorithms, agents, skills, hooks) and NOTHING declared which layer owns a given need. So the same capability got built twice, in two layers, reading two different sources, and both rotted. Measured examples are below: two brain-search implementations reading DIFFERENT files, and two ABAP write paths one of which bypasses the entire INC-CLASS-LOSS remediation.
_rule: One capability, one owner. A second implementation is either DEPRECATED with a pointer to the owner, or it is a defect. capability_ownership_check.py enforces it.

deprecated.why: A DIFFERENT source. It cannot see the entity index, the companion graph, OPEN WORK or WHAT WE KNOW DEEPLY - everything s099 added. Two answers to the same question with nothing saying which is right is worse than one incomplete answer.

The best-designed write path we have - 9 gates, PRE/POST readback, diff-gate - and still deprecated HERE, because the capability is out of scope for this project. It stays as the reference design and as the INC-CLASS-LOSS recovery record, not as something to run.

mcp_server_whole.authoritative: none - the MCP server is NOT part of the current architecture
mcp_server_whole.status: DEPRECATED s099. No .mcp.json, `mcp` package absent, 16 tools never invoked.

deprecated.why: Connecting it would resurrect brain_search reading a DIFFERENT brain source than graph_queries, and adt_deploy writing to D01 with none of the gates built after INC-CLASS-LOSS. Reviving an unrun parallel layer adds conflict, not capability.

_the_decision_s099: The architecture that WORKS today is: Python scripts + the graph_queries CLI + 4 hooks + quality_checks discovered by glob. That layer ran mechanically all session, unattended. The MCP server is a parallel universe that NEVER RAN - no .mcp.json, its dependency not installed, 16 tools nobody ever called. JP: 'no tomar algo viejo y enchufarlo'. So it is NOT connected. It is deprecated whole. Where it had a genuinely better idea - golden reads carrying provenance and freshness instead of 15 ad-hoc sqlite3 snippets - the IDEA is ported into the working layer, not the code.
_scope_s099: WHAT THIS PROJECT DOES: read SAP (read-only), extract to the golden, analyse code from the extracted corpora, build and query the brain, run recurring checks, produce companions. WHAT IT DOES NOT DO: deploy ABAP. JP, s099: 'El desplegar abap no lo hacemos con este proyecto'. So no write path here has an owner - the capability is out of scope, which is stronger than saying one implementation is preferred over another.
